Progressive quotas are a building pass. New identities get 2 slots. Each verified epoch adds 2, up to 40. The pass climbs only with work.
Idle 3 epochs, the pass drops 4 slots. Forgery resets it to 2, freezes rewards 6 epochs. Repeat forgery doubles the climb.
The dune of cost is time. Reaching 40 slots takes 19 epochs. A bridge of 1,000 high-quota identities costs 152,000. An inlet of fake passes dries fast: resets send the forger back down.
